knowledge_point.title: Finding a Unit Vector Parallel to a Given Vector

question.:question/problem: The vector $\mathbf{a}$ has magnitude $2$. Find a unit vector that is parallel to $\mathbf{a}$.
question.:question/worked-solution:
To obtain the unit vector that is parallel to $\mathbf{a}$, we divide $\mathbf{a}$ by its length:

$$
\mathbf{u}=\dfrac{\mathbf{a}}{\mid \,\mathbf{a}\, \mid}=\dfrac{1}{2}\mathbf{a}
$$
